opportunities.title: LPDP–NAIST: take your STEM ambitions to Japan
opportunities.description: Pursue a master's or doctoral degree at Nara Institute of Science and Technology through LPDP's partnership scholarship. Choose Information Science, Biological Science, or Materials Science and build expertise for your next chapter.
opportunities.eligibility: Indonesian citizens with an S1/D4 degree for master's study or an S2 degree for doctoral study. Minimum GPA 3.00/4.00 and the required English-language qualification. Applications must be submitted to both NAIST and LPDP.
benefits: Up to 24 months of master's or 36 months of doctoral funding
Tuition and eligible study support
Travel, visa, and living support under LPDP terms

opportunities.title: The 9th International Conference on Mathematics and Natural Sciences
opportunities.description: Three days of ideas, research, and scientific connections at ITB. ICMNS brings together international researchers across mathematics and the natural sciences, with work spanning health, food, and renewable energy.
opportunities.eligibility: Researchers and the wider scientific community. Review the conference website for participation and registration requirements.
benefits: International plenary and invited speakers
Research across mathematics and natural sciences
Conversations and connections with fellow researchers

opportunities.title: Google AI Essentials: turn curiosity into a new skill
opportunities.description: Get hands-on with generative AI, write more effective prompts, and learn to use AI responsibly. This five-module online course is built by Google and designed to fit around your studies.
opportunities.eligibility: No previous AI or technical experience required. Available through Coursera; review current local pricing before enrolling.
benefits: Five practical learning modules
Learn at your own pace
A shareable Google certificate upon completion

opportunities.title: Find a cause. Make a difference with Indorelawan.
opportunities.description: Connect with social organizations and find volunteering activities across Indonesia. Explore causes that matter to you, from education and literacy to the environment and community wellbeing.
opportunities.eligibility: Eligibility, schedules, location, and participation requirements are set by each organization. Choose an activity on Indorelawan to see the full details.
benefits: Discover social causes and organizations
Find activities by interest and location
Build experience while contributing to your community

opportunities.title: Erasmus+: a different campus, a wider perspective
opportunities.description: Explore a study exchange that becomes part of your degree. Erasmus+ supports student mobility through participating universities and their institutional partnerships, with opportunities to develop language, cultural, and academic skills.
opportunities.eligibility: Students enrolled in a participating higher education institution. Your university must have a suitable agreement with the receiving institution. Contact your international office; there is no central student application form.
benefits: Study mobility of 2–12 months for long-term exchanges
Academic credit recognition through a learning agreement
Travel and living contributions subject to institutional funding

opportunities.title: LPDP–UCD: your next chapter in Dublin
opportunities.description: A master's scholarship at University College Dublin for Indonesian graduates in engineering and architecture, health and agriculture, and science. Study with up to 12 months of funding through the LPDP–UCD partnership.
opportunities.eligibility: Indonesian S1/D4 graduates who meet the program's age, GPA, English-language, and other requirements. Submit parallel applications to UCD and LPDP; existing master's graduates are not eligible for this master's award.
benefits: Up to 12 months of master's funding
Eligible tuition and study costs
Living, travel, and visa support under LPDP terms

opportunities.title: Build your next career with Google Career Certificates
opportunities.description: Explore flexible professional training in UX design, data analytics, IT support, cybersecurity, project management, and other growing fields. Learn online with courses designed by Google.
opportunities.eligibility: Many entry-level certificates require no previous experience. Course requirements, duration, language, and local pricing vary; see the individual program before enrolling.
benefits: Practical, job-relevant skills
A flexible online learning schedule
Shareable professional credentials

opportunities.title: Titanic: Machine Learning from Disaster
opportunities.description: Take your first step into a machine learning competition with Kaggle's Titanic challenge. Explore the competition's dataset, build a prediction model, and learn from the community's approaches.
opportunities.eligibility: Review Kaggle's competition rules and account requirements before participating. The competition is designed as an introduction to machine learning competitions.
benefits: Practice with a real competition dataset
Build and evaluate a prediction model
Explore community notebooks and discussions

opportunities.title: Find your people with GDG on Campus
opportunities.description: Connect with a student developer community, get hands-on experience, and build skills alongside people who share your curiosity. Explore Google Developer Groups on Campus through Google's community directory.
opportunities.eligibility: Find a local chapter and review its events and participation details. Activities and availability vary by campus and community.
benefits: Peer learning and student connections
Hands-on technical activities
A community for your technology journey
